events.text_en: Trọng Tế Thế of Lễ Tuyền goes ahead of the school's healers into fevered Cựu Khê Trấn and dies of the fever; his name is written over the sick-hall door.
Liêm Cam Lộ dies sitting by the sweet spring; Mai Lễ Tuyền becomes head.
Mai Lễ Tuyền raises the Dawn Hall on the shore of Triêu Hà Hồ, where she delivered Phượng Minh's head in 950, and moves the healers down from the spring; the brewers keep the Spring House.
The Spring House's porters begin to cart lake water from the Dawn Hall up to the sweet spring, a fortnight's road, in barrels sealed as the healers' tinctures.
The Pivot's table tastes the lake in Lễ Tuyền's wine. Thiên Xu says nothing in public, takes forty jars of pure spring a year as a fine, and sends a cellar steward to live at the Spring House.
